description.value: Drumroaster Coffee is a family-owned specialty coffee roastery and café that has been roasting and serving ethically sourced beans since 2007, located in Cobble Hill just off the Trans-Canada Highway. The Oglend family brings decades of coffee industry experience, sourcing directly from farms in Colombia, Ethiopia, Peru, Kenya, and Guatemala with a philosophy of long-term producer relationships. It is a local anchor on Vancouver Island's cycling corridor, with its beans served at cafés from Tofino to Victoria.
